# Ticketing ops sync, 10 October

Attendees: Priya Raman, Rhys Calloway, Ellie Thornbury, Sofia Marchetti

- Saturday at Kingsport FC: 31 of the held-back easy-access seats were empty while general sale was sold out. Harbour Athletic sees the same most weeks.
- **Decided:** easy-access seats (step-free and aisle seats held for disabled supporters and companions) that are still unbooked 72 hours before kick-off are released to general sale. Wheelchair spaces themselves are never released.
- Priya to add a scheduled release job; Rhys and Ellie to tell the clubs' disability liaison officers before it goes live.
